lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: Yeah, that’s fair. She’s way better than me at essentially everything.
: Hahah. I’m only kidding, Sensei :) You’ll always be my favorite
: But I have grown really fond of Miss Imai. She’s so amazing and beautiful and inspiring.
: Did something happen?
: Yes :) But we decided to keep it a secret, so I can’t tell you :P
: Futaba, are you cheating on me with my underling?
: Wouldn’t cheating imply that you and me are dating? :)
: You know what I mean.
: Hahaha, of course I know what you mean. And no. I am not cheating on you with Miss Imai.
: We just found out there’s a little something we have in common.
: And even though it was a sad conversation, it helped a lot. For me at least.
: I can’t really tell how she feels, but I hope it was the same for her.
: I’m sure it was. Imani’s a good person and I’m glad you two are getting along.
: Thank you, Sensei :) Me too
: Just know that if you two ever DO hook up that I would like to be there so I can watch.
: Pervert. Hahah
: Or participate. Whatever is better for you two.
: I think Miss Imai is a little more...apprehensive about physical contact with students than you are, Sensei :P
: Well, she’s missing out on a great time.
: Thank you very much :P I do my best
: And I hope that both of you will continue to take care of me.
: Yeah, maybe until her pants come off and you realize she can’t fuck you the way I do
: Oh wow O_O
: Wasn’t expecting that hahaha
: There’s normally a little more build-up before your perverted side comes out :P
: Yeah, but if Imani is trying to steal you away from me, that means war and I must pull out all the stops.
: And of course the first stop was being horny :)
: Being horny is my love language.
: I don’t think that’s a love language, Sensei :P You’re probably thinking of physical touch.
: Well it’s hard to have sex without that aspect, so I can’t see how I’m in the wrong here.
: Hahah! No, I guess you’re not. But if you’re worried about your penis being the deciding factor in why I have joined Team Imani, fear not. Because that has nothing to do with it :)
: Oh, I have no problem with you liking her more. I just reserve the right to be the one who gets to have sex with you.
: How romantic :P
: At the end of the day, you’re both wonderful teachers who excel in different things and I greatly appreciate both of you.
: You’ve done more for my self-esteem than anything else ever has and I’m eternally grateful for that :)
: And Sensei, as a special thank you to you since I know it’s what you want to hear...
: I love your dick <3 :)
: Please continue putting it inside of me :D
: Congratulations on your engagement, Futaba. I’m very happy for you.
: Thank you, Sensei. I’ve been waiting my whole life for this and I’m sure I’ll make an excellent bride.
: You two will have beautiful children.
: And we’ll defy all laws of nature in creating them :)
: Jokes aside, I’m not actually getting married. Hahaha
: Could’ve fooled me with how close the two of you seem to look all of a sudden.
: Yes, well...things happened ;)
: Oh
: That was meant to be a normal smile. I didn’t hit shift.
: I promise I’m not suggesting anything.
: What sort of “things” happened, Futaba? You’re acting really suspicious right now.
: I am not! I just missed a button!
: All that happened was a little talk, that’s all. And it turns out that Miss Imai and I aren’t all that different at the end of the day.
: I believe that. You’re both extremely attractive and like books.
: Hahah! There’s more to us than that, Sensei. But yes, Miss Imai is very pretty.
: And you.
: If you say so :)
: Futaba.
: You’re beautiful.
: If you say soooooo :)
: Stop with the smiles while subtly self-deprecating. It makes me feel like I’m losing this conversation.
: I have to go now :)
: Byeeeeee :)
